items.title: Meta Settlement a Start, But Incomplete: Lawmakers
items.summary: Connecticut Democratic Sen. Richard Blumenthal says last week's $17 billion settlement by Meta Platforms over social media addiction was a welcome step forward, but incomplete.  Blumenthal, who is co-sponsoring the Kids Online Safety Act with Tennessee Republican Marsha Blackburn, said the settlement pertains to Meta only, not YouTube or TikTok, that it limits only some of the addictive features on social media platforms, and it only lasts for 10 years.  "It will not keep pace with an evolving technology," Blumenthal told CBS News' Face the Nation.
